main.description: Store an attachment reference under orf_server_map(caller device state, blindedIndex), with orf_server_map(state, blindedToken) as its access MAC, and pin the blob against object GC. Entitlement: blobId must be a bound attachment blob of conversationId whose application binding names messageId (the chat message id is the Labyrinth messageId), and the calling chat device must hold the application interval covering that entry. Unlinkability (decision J4): the server keeps the owner DID and the (conversationId, messageId) pair only as keyed digests; a blob may be referenced for one message only. Local conversations only. ORF endpoint ([CB-17]): states are per device of the caller DID; the server never reveals one. Common errors: NotAuthorized, AccountSessionExpired, DeviceRevoked, RateLimited, InvalidRequest, PayloadTooLarge, QuotaExceeded.

blindedToken.description: orf_client_map output for the access token.
